proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10383 mriyate explicitly gives Khowar bri- die in the addendum and brik in the main entry. These bri-/brī- stems match that direct comparison; the hyphen is stem notation. Exact survey form brī- is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
